blocks.html: Brackets used to support cantilevered loads shall be seated with side-brackets parallel to the frame and end-brackets at 90 degrees (1.57 rad) to the frames shall not be bent or twisted from these positions and shall be used only to support light duty loads of up to 25 pounds per square foot (122.05 kg/m 2 ), unless the design provisions of Section 3314.3 have been met.
